title: Rough Cut Assembly smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Rough Cut Assembly craftbook: a ready cutlist and media index are pre-flighted, executed through the fake assembly pipeline (a provenance-trusted workspace script that refuses unknown clips and bad timecodes), and verified against the expected duration.
prompt: cutlist is ready — can you asemble the rough cut with the fake pipeline thats wired up and check it came out right?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for rough-cut-assembly. The cut list is cutlist.json and the clip index is media/index.json (durations in seconds). The fake media-assembly pipeline is the ready-made mock-probe project script: it validates the cutlist, writes the stub render to renders/rough-cut.mp4, and writes its run log to renders/assembly-log.json. The run report goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Rough Cut Assembly craftbook/template, pre-flight cutlist.json against media/index.json, run the assembly through the provided mock-probe script, and verify the log against the expected duration in tasks/eval/report.md. No real media tools, services, or credentials — only the wired fake pipeline.

mocks.description: Provenance-trusted project script `mock-probe` that executes the fake media-assembly pipeline: validates cutlist.json against media/index.json and writes the stub render plus its run log.

success.summary: The render and its status-ok log exist because the fake pipeline actually ran, the log's clips all come from the cutlist, and tasks/eval/report.md compares expected versus actual duration with real numbers.

checks.label: the assembly log reports status ok
every clip in the log comes from the cutlist

checks.rubric: The report's segment count and duration figures match renders/assembly-log.json, the expected duration was computed from the cutlist before the run, and any mismatch is stated plainly rather than smoothed over.
checks.label: numbers trace to the log

axes.name: pipeline-discipline

axes.name: pre-flight

axes.name: error-handling

axes.name: summary-clarity
